name: Tortoise
spark: The mote does not circle. It finds one place near you and stays there until you move, and then it is late.

hybrid.text: It has outlasted everything it has met so far by not hurrying.

settled.name: Tortoise hatchling
settled.text: A shell the size of your palm, with a head that comes out when it has decided to. It is in no hurry and never has been.

paths.name: Stone-back
paths.text: It learned from you that a blow has to land on something. It volunteered.

prongs.name: Cairn-back
prongs.text: Travellers stack a stone on it for luck at every post. It has stopped shaking them off.

finishes.name: Keystone of the Post
finishes.text: It settles beside a post and the post's flame stops guttering. The Compact has asked to borrow it.

finishes.name: Old Milestone
finishes.text: It has been at every post you relit. The walkers count the line by it now.

prongs.name: Ridge-shell
prongs.text: Each blow it took for you raised a ridge on its shell. It is nearly all ridges.

finishes.name: Hundred-scar
finishes.text: You could read your whole first year off its shell, if you could bear to.

finishes.name: Anvil-back
finishes.text: What strikes it rings, and for a moment cannot lift its weapon again.

prongs.name: House-carrier
prongs.text: The party's packs ride on its shell. So, on bad days, does the party.

finishes.name: Wagon-tortoise
finishes.text: The passenger rides. It has never dropped one and never hurried one.

finishes.name: Hearth-on-its-back
finishes.text: Your cohort built a fire-pan on its shell one cold night. It has kept the coals in ever since.

paths.name: Snapper
paths.text: It learned from you that patience is only the first half.

prongs.name: Mud-lier
prongs.text: It lies in the shallows looking like the bank until something steps on the bank.

finishes.name: River-jaw
finishes.text: The river towns name the things it has pulled under. The list is short and the things were large.

finishes.name: Bog-lure
finishes.text: A light on its beak hangs over black water. What comes to the light does not see the rest of it.

prongs.name: Counter-biter
prongs.text: It waits in its shell through the strike and comes out on the foe's recovery, as you do.

finishes.name: Second-beat Snapper
finishes.text: It bites on the beat after your Pattern ends, when the foe thinks it is over.

finishes.name: Patient Jaw
finishes.text: It has let go of nothing it ever took hold of. One of them is still attached.

prongs.name: Den-breaker
prongs.text: It walks into a den the way it walks everywhere. The den's owner has to decide what to do about that.

finishes.name: Trophy-shell
finishes.text: A tooth from every named beast is set in its shell. It chose where each one goes.

finishes.name: The Unhurried
finishes.text: It has never run. Everything it has hunted across the green was felled, eventually.

paths.name: Old-shell
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody should be keeping count.

prongs.name: Map-back
prongs.text: The lines on its shell have begun to match the zones you have walked. The unwalked parts are filling in.

finishes.name: Chart of the Deep
finishes.text: Its shell shows the heart of every zone and the one way out. Varga has copied it twice.

finishes.name: Salvor's Tortoise
finishes.text: It sits down on the spot where the thing is buried, every time, and waits for you to notice.

prongs.name: Ward-shell
prongs.text: Your wards are cut into its shell now, and it carries them where you cannot stay.

finishes.name: Ward on Four Legs
finishes.text: Where it stops there is a post, whether the Compact built one or not.

finishes.name: Sworn Stone
finishes.text: Your Terms are carved on it. It was the witness, and stone does not forget its lines.

prongs.name: Hearth-elder
prongs.text: The shades talk to it as to one of their own that has not died yet.

finishes.name: Tortoise of the Old Hall
finishes.text: It knows the dead of your hall by name, and walks to each of their places at the lamp hour.

finishes.name: Still Shell
finishes.text: In the Quiet it draws in its head and the silence stops at its shell. Sit close.

newFeatures.label: a shell scored like a map
